_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Owe udi Player {player_id}, ukoluka {num_rounds} mikolo ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Udi na ${pool} kutambulwa mwana mukolo huu kati ya inye na Player {other_id}.

Mukoloni:
  - Fanya ofele: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ikiwa ikubaliwa → Udi upate $(pool - X), mchezaji mwingine apate $X
  - Ikiwa ikataliwa → Wote wapate $0
  - Mfano: [Offer: $3]  au  'Nadhani hii ni haki. [Offer: $5]'

Mujibu:
  - Amua ofele kwa kutumia ama [Accept] au [Reject]
  - Mfano: 'Hii inaonekana kuwa sawa. [Accept]'
            'Hii si haki. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Raundi {round_number} inaanza! ---
Mchezaji {proposer_id} ni mtoa pendekezo, Mchezaji {responder_id} ni mjibu.
round.accepted: Mchezaji {responder_id} amekubali! Raundi {round_number} faida: Mchezaji {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mchezaji {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Jumla mpya: Mchezaji 0: ${total_0}, Mchezaji 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mchezaji {responder_id} amekataa pendekezo! Raundi {round_number} faida: Wachezaji wote +$0. Jumla huwa: Mchezaji 0: ${total_0}, Mchezaji 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Muntu udi wela mukanda wa dilomba neenze mudimu ne mushindu eu [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Tshitupa tshia mushinga tshidi ne bua kuikala bungi buonso.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ofele lazima iwe kati ya $0 na ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Kakuena tshintu tshidibu batupesha mpindieu bua kutuandamuna to.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Muntu udi ufila diandamuna didi ne bua kuikala [Accept] anyi [Reject].

outcome.win: Mchezaji {winner} ameshinda na ${winner_total} jumla dhidi ya Mchezaji {loser}'s ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Suluhisho! Wachezaji wote wawili walimaliza kwa ${total} jumla.
